parts.stem:
Calcium carbonate can be converted into calcium hydroxide in a two-step process.

parts.text: Describe how the two-step process is carried out to convert calcium carbonate into calcium hydroxide. Include relevant equations.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem: Gallium is a silver-grey solid. Aluminium and gallium share many similar chemical properties.
parts.text: Construct an equation for the reaction of gallium when heated in oxygen to form gallium oxide, $\text{Ga}_2\text{O}_3$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Deduce the oxidation number of gallium in $\text{Ga}_2\text{O}_3$.

parts.text:
